appliedProposals.rationale: power-recalibrate the simulated field’s target ownership (own^γ — chalk sharpens, tail thins). LARGE 1.33 SUPERSEDES rather than contradicts 1.17: same direction, under-corrected magnitude, which is what a universal compression with bucket-specific magnitude predicts. MAIN 1.23 is direction-near-certain and magnitude-LOW-CONFIDENCE at n=8; the keep rule carries the weight, not the point estimate. MAIN GETS PURE GAMMA — the v59.6 ownFieldHead compose is gated large-only. KEEP RULES: large, fresh looks at 3 and 6 new graded large slates, revert if worse than the 1.17 LOOK record (the bar is the incumbent, not base); main, looks at 3 and 6 graded MAIN-BUCKET slates (6-7 games — these accrue at roughly 10 per 35 days, so count bucket-slates, never calendar days), revert if worse than flat. SECOND JAW, required because the cash-line jaw is one-sided: under a negative level bias the cash line is beaten by ANY γ above the incumbent, including a γ that is too HIGH, so it detects under-correction and never over-correction. So on each new graded large slate also read the SIGNED concentration residual, defined realized MINUS corrected-sim (the same sign as the original +12.0 own-pt gap, where positive meant the sim ran too flat): it must stay within ±2 of zero, and a persistently NEGATIVE residual means the corrected sim is now more concentrated than reality, i.e. γ is too high — that is the revert signal the cash line structurally cannot produce. γ corrects the field’s CONCENTRATION, not per-player projection accuracy, and it is currently also absorbing a field-level deficit in the generated cash line — that deficit is registered as its own defect and γ will be over-corrected if it is ever fixed without re-reading these looks.
appliedProposals.evidence: BUCKET CENSUS FIRST: the 33-night panel is 23 LARGE / 8 MAIN / 2 small — main_dk is a LARGE-bucket slate on 23 of 33 nights, so the earlier main=1.28 was fitted on large-dominated data and is WITHDRAWN by its author. Bucket-split fits: large 1.327, main 1.232. IDENTIFYING evidence is the ownership-concentration gap (the statistic that targets the quantity being corrected), n=23 large / n=8 main. The held-out cash line is DIRECTIONALLY CONSISTENT but NON-IDENTIFYING: it falls monotonically in γ across 1.00/1.17/1.25/1.33/1.40/1.50 (|err| 7.35 to 5.55 on 9 rollup nights), because mean SIGNED error is negative everywhere (−2.90 at γ=1 rising to −0.27 at γ=1.50) — the field under-produces the cash line and any sharpening reduces that deficit, so this metric would drive γ to the clamp and cannot choose 1.33 over 1.40. Magnitude rests on concentration, not on cash line. LARGE MAGNITUDE UNCERTAINTY: half-sample fits span 1.28-1.37 (odd/even) and 1.295-1.361 (temporal split, the stricter one), cross-half transplant residuals ±3.5-4.0 own-pts against ±1.0 on the pooled panel — DIRECTION certain (every half fits at or above 1.28, far above the live 1.17), MAGNITUDE ±0.05, and the keep-rule bears the weight. 1.33 is a central estimate, not a measured constant.
